description: 获客、激活试用、实际支付及订阅收入业务域；通过成熟队列漏斗与有效期订阅快照诊断。

tables.name: business_calendar
tables.description: 日期维度，月末快照以calendar_date为观测点

tables.name: account_attribution
tables.description: 单一主来源归属，非多触点因果归因

tables.name: feature_events
tables.description: 账户首次价值事件及触发用户

tables.name: account_usage
tables.description: 产品使用与错误事件聚合，不等于客户流失原因

tables.name: payment_attempts
tables.description: 同一账单可多次支付尝试，success才是成功支付

tables.name: subscription_versions
tables.description: 订阅价格有效期版本；左闭右开，可有取消后的恢复区间

relations.description: 月末日期落在订阅版本有效区间，不能用任意非等值JOIN代替此批准关系。
relations.preaggregation: 每个订阅在任意时点最多一个有效版本；先按时点账户汇总MRR，禁止与事件事实明细直接关联。

metrics.name: 月度经常性收入
metrics.description: 指定月末仍生效的订阅版本月价，effective_from<=时点且(effective_to为空或>时点)。已月度归一，不再次除12；需使用版本表处理升降级与恢复，而不是订阅主表当前字段。

metrics.name: 成熟账户实际付费漏斗
metrics.description: 同一注册账户成熟30日队列内，依次达到首次价值、试用、成功支付；账户去重，支付重试不能重复计人。与仅按订阅开通定义的30日转化分开。
filters: 注册账户已完整观察30天

metrics.name: 期初账户群净收入留存率
metrics.description: 固定期初有正MRR的账户集合，其报告期MRR/期初MRR；允许扩张超过100%，不混入报告期新账户。
metrics.denominator: 固定期初账户群的期初MRR

metrics.name: 注册队列周龄留存率
metrics.description: 按注册月份划分用户队列。周龄w的留存分子为注册后[7*w,7*w+6]天至少发生一次workspace_open的去重用户；多周比较统一使用已完整观察到最大周龄的成熟队列，保留样本量。第1/4/8周分别对应7-13/28-34/56-62天。
filters: 注册用户已完整观察最大周龄
metrics.denominator: 相同最大观察窗口下的成熟注册用户数

metrics.name: 支付失败影响账单数
metrics.description: 按失败原因统计至少一次失败尝试的去重账单；同一账单可属于多个原因，不可跨原因直接合计去重账单数。失败后可能重试成功，不等于最终坏账。

business_knowledge.title: 历史MRR需使用版本有效期
business_knowledge.content: 升降级或恢复后，订阅主表无法代表所有历史月价。历史MRR按subscription_versions左闭右开区间取值；期初/期末账户净变动与全期间事件毛额不同。

business_knowledge.title: 开通与收款转化分开
business_knowledge.content: 订阅开通与真实成功支付是两种不同的转化定义。顺序漏斗只能使用同一成熟账户队列，并按账户去重支付重试；未成熟队列不算未转化。

diagnostics.title: 成熟账户获客到实际支付漏斗

queries.sql: WITH f AS(SELECT account_id,MIN(event_date) first_value FROM feature_events WHERE event_type='first_value' GROUP BY account_id),t AS(SELECT account_id,MIN(start_date) trial_started FROM trials GROUP BY account_id),p AS(SELECT i.account_id,MIN(a.attempt_date) paid_date FROM invoices i JOIN payment_attempts a ON i.invoice_id=a.invoice_id WHERE a.outcome='success' GROUP BY i.account_id) SELECT strftime(a.signup_date,'%Y-%m') period,date_trunc('month',a.signup_date)::DATE period_date,a.acquisition_channel AS "group",COUNT(*) registered,COUNT(*) FILTER(WHERE f.first_value>=a.signup_date AND f.first_value<=a.signup_date+INTERVAL '30 days') activated,COUNT(*) FILTER(WHERE f.first_value>=a.signup_date AND t.trial_started>=f.first_value AND t.trial_started<=a.signup_date+INTERVAL '30 days') trial_started,COUNT(*) FILTER(WHERE f.first_value>=a.signup_date AND t.trial_started>=f.first_value AND p.paid_date>=t.trial_started AND p.paid_date<=a.signup_date+INTERVAL '30 days') paid FROM accounts a LEFT JOIN f ON a.account_id=f.account_id LEFT JOIN t ON a.account_id=t.account_id LEFT JOIN p ON a.account_id=p.account_id WHERE date_trunc('month',a.signup_date)+INTERVAL '1 month'+INTERVAL '29 days'<=DATE '2025-12-31' GROUP BY 1,2,3 ORDER BY 1,3

diagnostics.title: 订阅收入净变动与客户使用线索

queries.sql: SELECT strftime(c.calendar_date,'%Y-%m-%d') period,c.calendar_date period_date,v.account_id,SUM(v.monthly_price) mrr,MIN(s.start_date) first_started FROM business_calendar c JOIN subscription_versions v ON c.calendar_date>=v.effective_from AND(c.calendar_date<v.effective_to OR v.effective_to IS NULL) JOIN subscriptions s ON v.subscription_id=s.subscription_id WHERE c.is_month_end AND c.calendar_date>=DATE '2025-09-01' GROUP BY c.calendar_date,v.account_id ORDER BY c.calendar_date,v.account_id

SELECT a.account_id,a.account_name,SUM(u.active_users) active_user_days,SUM(u.critical_actions) critical_actions,SUM(u.error_events) error_events FROM accounts a JOIN account_usage u ON a.account_id=u.account_id WHERE u.usage_date>=DATE '2025-07-01' GROUP BY a.account_id,a.account_name ORDER BY error_events DESC

dashboard_templates.title: 产品增长与订阅收入看板

query.sql: WITH f AS(SELECT account_id,MIN(event_date) first_value FROM feature_events WHERE event_type='first_value' GROUP BY account_id),t AS(SELECT account_id,MIN(start_date) trial_started FROM trials GROUP BY account_id),p AS(SELECT i.account_id,MIN(a.attempt_date) paid_date FROM invoices i JOIN payment_attempts a ON i.invoice_id=a.invoice_id WHERE a.outcome='success' GROUP BY i.account_id) SELECT strftime(a.signup_date,'%Y-%m') period,date_trunc('month',a.signup_date)::DATE period_date,a.acquisition_channel AS "group",COUNT(*) registered,COUNT(*) FILTER(WHERE f.first_value>=a.signup_date AND f.first_value<=a.signup_date+INTERVAL '30 days') activated,COUNT(*) FILTER(WHERE f.first_value>=a.signup_date AND t.trial_started>=f.first_value AND t.trial_started<=a.signup_date+INTERVAL '30 days') trial_started,COUNT(*) FILTER(WHERE f.first_value>=a.signup_date AND t.trial_started>=f.first_value AND p.paid_date>=t.trial_started AND p.paid_date<=a.signup_date+INTERVAL '30 days') paid FROM accounts a LEFT JOIN f ON a.account_id=f.account_id LEFT JOIN t ON a.account_id=t.account_id LEFT JOIN p ON a.account_id=p.account_id WHERE date_trunc('month',a.signup_date)+INTERVAL '1 month'+INTERVAL '29 days'<=DATE '2025-12-31' GROUP BY 1,2,3 ORDER BY 1,3

SELECT strftime(c.calendar_date,'%Y-%m-%d') period,c.calendar_date period_date,v.account_id,SUM(v.monthly_price) mrr,MIN(s.start_date) first_started FROM business_calendar c JOIN subscription_versions v ON c.calendar_date>=v.effective_from AND(c.calendar_date<v.effective_to OR v.effective_to IS NULL) JOIN subscriptions s ON v.subscription_id=s.subscription_id WHERE c.is_month_end AND c.calendar_date>=DATE '2025-09-01' GROUP BY c.calendar_date,v.account_id ORDER BY c.calendar_date,v.account_id
SELECT SUM(monthly_price) mrr FROM subscription_versions WHERE effective_from<=DATE '2025-11-30' AND(effective_to>DATE '2025-11-30' OR effective_to IS NULL)

SELECT c.calendar_date period_date,SUM(v.monthly_price) mrr FROM business_calendar c JOIN subscription_versions v ON c.calendar_date>=v.effective_from AND(c.calendar_date<v.effective_to OR v.effective_to IS NULL) WHERE c.is_month_end GROUP BY c.calendar_date ORDER BY c.calendar_date

cards.title: 用户注册月×周龄留存（成熟队列）

query.sql: WITH observed AS(SELECT u.user_id,u.signup_date,MAX(CASE WHEN e.event_date>=u.signup_date+INTERVAL '7 days' AND e.event_date<u.signup_date+INTERVAL '14 days' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) w1,MAX(CASE WHEN e.event_date>=u.signup_date+INTERVAL '28 days' AND e.event_date<u.signup_date+INTERVAL '35 days' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) w4,MAX(CASE WHEN e.event_date>=u.signup_date+INTERVAL '56 days' AND e.event_date<u.signup_date+INTERVAL '63 days' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) w8 FROM users u LEFT JOIN events e ON u.user_id=e.user_id WHERE u.signup_date+INTERVAL '62 days'<=DATE '2025-12-31' GROUP BY u.user_id,u.signup_date) SELECT date_trunc('month',signup_date)::DATE period_date,'第1周' age,100.0*SUM(w1)/COUNT(*) retention_pct,COUNT(*) sample_size FROM observed GROUP BY 1 UNION ALL SELECT date_trunc('month',signup_date)::DATE period_date,'第4周' age,100.0*SUM(w4)/COUNT(*) retention_pct,COUNT(*) sample_size FROM observed GROUP BY 1 UNION ALL SELECT date_trunc('month',signup_date)::DATE period_date,'第8周' age,100.0*SUM(w8)/COUNT(*) retention_pct,COUNT(*) sample_size FROM observed GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 1,2

cards.title: 支付失败原因（账单去重）

query.sql: SELECT failure_reason,COUNT(DISTINCT invoice_id) affected_invoices FROM payment_attempts WHERE outcome='failed' GROUP BY failure_reason ORDER BY affected_invoices DESC

evaluation.question: 2025年12月31日MRR是多少？
evaluation.sql: SELECT SUM(monthly_price) AS mrr FROM subscription_versions WHERE effective_from<=DATE '2025-12-31' AND(effective_to IS NULL OR effective_to>DATE '2025-12-31')

evaluation.question: 各获客活动归属多少账户？
evaluation.sql: SELECT c.campaign_name,COUNT(*) accounts FROM acquisition_campaigns c JOIN account_attribution a ON c.campaign_id=a.campaign_id GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 1

evaluation.question: 2025年各来源首次价值激活账户数？
evaluation.sql: SELECT a.acquisition_channel,COUNT(DISTINCT f.account_id) activated FROM accounts a JOIN feature_events f ON a.account_id=f.account_id WHERE a.signup_date>=DATE '2025-01-01' GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 1

evaluation.question: 2025年第四季度注册账户中开始试用的账户数？
evaluation.sql: SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT t.account_id) trial_accounts FROM accounts a JOIN trials t ON a.account_id=t.account_id WHERE a.signup_date>=DATE '2025-10-01'

evaluation.question: 各支付结果有多少次尝试？
evaluation.sql: SELECT outcome,COUNT(*) attempts FROM payment_attempts GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 1

evaluation.question: 2025年10月1日发生多少次套餐扩张或收缩事件？
evaluation.sql: SELECT change_type,COUNT(*) changes FROM subscription_changes WHERE change_date=DATE '2025-10-01' AND change_type IN ('expanded','contracted') GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 1

evaluation.question: 2025年11月恢复订阅的MRR合计？
evaluation.sql: SELECT SUM(new_mrr) restored_mrr FROM subscription_changes WHERE change_type='reactivated' AND change_date>=DATE '2025-11-01' AND change_date<DATE '2025-12-01'

evaluation.question: 2025年9月30日有效版本的MRR是多少？
evaluation.sql: SELECT SUM(monthly_price) mrr FROM subscription_versions WHERE effective_from<=DATE '2025-09-30' AND(effective_to IS NULL OR effective_to>DATE '2025-09-30')

evaluation.question: 2025年各行业产品关键动作数？
evaluation.sql: SELECT a.industry,SUM(u.critical_actions) actions FROM account_usage u JOIN accounts a ON u.account_id=a.account_id WHERE u.usage_date>=DATE '2025-01-01' GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 1

evaluation.question: 2025年第四季度各失败原因支付尝试数？
evaluation.sql: SELECT failure_reason,COUNT(*) failures FROM payment_attempts WHERE outcome='failed' AND attempt_date>=DATE '2025-10-01' GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 1

evaluation.question: 2025年12月末各套餐有效账户数？
evaluation.sql: SELECT plan,COUNT(DISTINCT account_id) accounts FROM subscription_versions WHERE effective_from<=DATE '2025-12-31' AND(effective_to IS NULL OR effective_to>DATE '2025-12-31') GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 1
